title: Teamfight Tactics patch 18.1 — Systems
content:
# Patch 18.1

## Systems

Patch 18.1 launches Enchanted Wilds on live. The Carousel returns. Units no longer retarget after returning from crowd control. Loot missed from Stage 4-7 or later PvE rounds can overflow to the next PvE round.

## Opening Encounters

New opening encounters include Completed Item Anvil Start, Reroll Subscription, and Item Forge. Loot Subscription, Artifact Anvil, and Reroll Start were removed.

title: Enchanted Wilds — Wisp mechanic
content:
# Enchanted Wilds

## Set Mechanic: Wisps

Wisps are split into seven categories: Champion, Combat, Misc, Shop, Gold/XP, Risky, and Item. They can only be purchased during the planning phase. A Wisp disappears after planning and reveals the unit hiding behind it. Wisps appear in every other shop. After Stage 5, every other Wisp is guaranteed to be a Combat Wisp.

title: TFT Set 18: Enchanted Wilds overview
content:
# Set 18

## Enchanted Wilds

Enchanted Wilds is Teamfight Tactics Set 18. Its theme is a forest filled with wild magic, Riftbeasts, Elderwood, a Yeti, and Wisps. Wisps grant unusual abilities and form the set's central mechanic.
